required_behaviors: Parse all fixed half-open maintenance intervals without dropping overlaps.
Build sorted per-machine calendars with union-preserving merge semantics and share them across all candidate paths.
Place each nonpreemptive operation in a complete machine-calendar gap for construction and every search operator.
Reject every accepted candidate that intersects any original maintenance interval on its selected machine while accepting exact half-open boundaries.
When an exact path is used, include fixed maintenance intervals in each machine NoOverlap constraint.

coupled_groups.rule: Every candidate path must share the fixed machine calendar and pass the same boundary semantics before comparison.
